summary: Reproduces unchanged on main and every release back to v1.4.1907. Not only a wording problem: hlsl::DiagnoseRegisterType (SemaHLSL.cpp:11866) has no AR_OBJECT_ACCELERATION_STRUCT case, so the 'u' is never diagnosed, and CGHLSLMS.cpp:3172 discards the register letter, binding the acceleration structure at t0. With nothing at t0 the shader compiles clean and silently binds elsewhere than written; the reported message is the allocator noticing the resulting SRV collision and correctly naming depth_buffer. DXC already emits 'invalid register specification, expected t binding' for StructuredBuffer at u0 on all 21 builds, so the fix is a missing switch arm, not new machinery.
title: [HLSL] Misleading error message when using a UAV register for a raytracing acceleration structure
